title: Timestamp
description: Canonical timestamp with RFC 3339 / ISO 8601 representation and optional timezone and precision metadata. Owner: platform/contracts. Timestamp meaning (occurred-at, recorded-at, effective-at) is declared by the consuming contract, not this schema.

iso8601.description: RFC 3339 timestamp. Always stored in UTC for cross-service consistency.

timezone.description: Original IANA timezone name, when relevant for display or local business rules. Not used for ordering or storage.

precision.description: Granularity of the timestamp. Defaults to microsecond if omitted.

unix_nanos.description: Unix epoch time in nanoseconds as a string, for systems that require numeric ordering without parsing.
